categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design and manufacturing of computer products including motherboards, mini PCs, notebooks, desktop computers, and IoT devices such as smart EV chargers. It also engages in printed circuit board (PCB) production and related electronic components manufacturing. The business includes ODM/OEM services and focuses on both consumer and commercial markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including multi-layer, high-frequency, and automotive-grade boards. It integrates latest generation processors (Intel and AMD) and supports AI computing with embedded NPUs in notebooks. Production processes include SMT, reflow soldering, AOI inspection, functional testing, and system assembly. The company also implements ISO standards for quality, environment, occupational health, and information security.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include ODM/OEM system manufacturers, regional system assemblers, distributors, and end-users in consumer, commercial, industrial, and automotive sectors. Major markets served are PC system integrators, gaming, education, AI applications, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure providers. The company targets global markets with a focus on Asia, Americas, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing bases in China (South China), Thailand, and sales coverage across Asia, Americas, and Europe. It has subsidiaries and offices in Hong Kong, Japan, USA, Korea, and Thailand. The sales distribution shows strong presence in Asia (70%), Americas (13%), and Europe (15%).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of PCBs, motherboards, and computer systems. It also engages in upstream activities through strategic partnerships with component suppliers and downstream through ODM/OEM services and direct sales to system integrators and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include product diversification with emphasis on AI-enabled notebooks, mini PCs, and IoT smart charging solutions. R&D focuses on next-generation Intel and AMD platforms, AI integration with NPUs, energy-efficient and environmentally friendly designs, and expansion into automotive electronics and low-earth orbit satellite communications. The company invests heavily in innovation, patent development, and sustainability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of computer hardware including motherboards, mini PCs, notebooks, and IoT devices. The company also earns from ODM/OEM manufacturing contracts and licensing of technology. Sales are conducted via global distribution channels, direct OEM partnerships, and branded product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global PC and component manufacturers in the motherboard, mini PC, and notebook segments. It holds a modest market share in motherboards (~3.21%) and desktops (~1.02%) globally, with a smaller share in notebooks (~0.05%). Competitive advantages include vertical integration, strong supply chain management, rapid market response, and specialized product offerings in AI and IoT sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue was approximately NT$17.5 billion, down 11.38% from the prior year, with a net loss of about NT$90 million. The company has a total asset base of around NT$23.7 billion and equity of NT$11.8 billion. Despite recent profitability challenges, the company maintains stable operations with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion, particularly in Thailand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customizable computer hardware products with advanced AI capabilities and energy-efficient designs. Its value proposition includes strong R&D capabilities, rapid product development cycles, comprehensive quality and environmental certifications, and integrated solutions for emerging markets such as AI computing, electric vehicle charging, and industrial IoT. The company also focuses on sustainability and customer satisfaction as key differentiators.
